cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Choose the Precedent
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which rule, custom, or prior decision will govern what happens now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Who gets the head seat: Grandma or the birthday child? We have traditions for both.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Fine. Which tradition decides who gets served first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Serve them together. Except there's only one birthday pudding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then choose before I bring it in: elders first or birthdays first? I can divide the pudding once somebody's had the wish.
